svg.aria-label: A loop whose rim moves: in a time dt each rim element dl sweeps a thin parallelogram of area v dt cross dl, so the flux through the loop grows by B dot that area, which is minus v cross B dot dl times dt
svg.text: A moving rim sweeps new area: the source of the motional term

text.tspan: Flux through a moving loop — the swept-area term of the Leibniz rule
